name: Inaricho
tagline: Tokyo in 12 minutes and Otemachi in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 24 minutes to Shinjuku, 31 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 1.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 1.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.7 m to 3.2 m, a difference of 1.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: マルエツプチ 稲荷町駅前店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 40 clinics and 43 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 全仁会上野病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is ライフ・エクステンション研究所付属永寿総合病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 赤坂見附→溜池山王, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Inaricho, but Shin-Okachimachi is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Inaricho. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Inaricho. One-room rents run about ¥12,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Ueno is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Inaricho is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Inaricho. It reaches Otemachi 5 minutes sooner than Inaricho. One-room rents run about ¥7,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速1号上野線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
浅草通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 22 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
